scope: Editorial confidence in the collected product report, not statistical probability, personal trustworthiness, product quality or financial certainty.
eligibility: An account-matched public sample with usable captions and at least one accepted priced product. Every accepted product needs a source assessment; otherwise the report is pending.
sourceRule: For each product, use the weaker provenance of its selected relationship and listing sources. Average across products, then multiply by 40. Direct primary = 1; indexed primary = 0.6; secondary = 0.3. Retrieval provenance does not establish current availability or truth of every claim.
coverageRule: 40 × evidence-v3 total / 100. This deliberately retains missing financial evidence and the existing volume caps; it does not relabel coverage alone as confidence.
corroborationRule: 20 × mean reviewed corroboration across products. None = 0. Product-line agreement between a directly retrieved creator caption and a separate brand listing = 0.5; exact variant, price, market and conditions independently matched = 1. Same-publisher pages, syndicated releases and unretrieved original captions do not count. Product-line agreement is not independent validation of the offer.
rounding: Round each of the three components to one decimal, then sum integer tenths. Rotten Onion Index = 100 minus confidence, to one decimal. Pending reports have neither a numeric index nor a rank.
ranking: Highest confidence first; equal scores share competition rank. Name and handle stabilize display ties. Pending profiles follow rated profiles in either confidence sort direction. Filtering does not recalculate global ranks.
